quest.title: The talkies are coming: {client}
quest.step: The sound test went badly. Decide how to save this career.

title: The sound test
text: {client} steps up to the microphone for a routine sound test. The technicians exchange glances. The voice that filled silent close-ups sounds thin and brittle through the horn speakers — and word travels fast in this town.

choices.label: Book the best voice coach in town ({money_fmt:6000})
choices.outcome: Three hours a day, scales and Shakespeare. In three months you will know whether it worked.

choices.label: Coach the delivery yourself

effects.text: You knew exactly what {client} needed to hear — and how. The second test sounds like a different person.

choices.outcome: You break the fear, not the voice: slower, lower, closer to the microphone. It works.
choices.outcome_fail: Your amateur session leaves {client} more rattled than before. This needs a professional.

choices.label: Pivot to silent prestige and character parts
choices.outcome: No microphones, no risk: you rebuild {client} as a face the talkies cannot replace. Smaller lights — but lights.

choices.label: Ignore the whispers
choices.outcome: Maybe the talkies are a fad. Maybe. The whispers stay.

quest.step: The coach drills {client} three hours a day. The test reel will decide.

title: The test reel
text: Twelve weeks of drills. The coach says {client} is ready — the studio wants proof on film before anyone signs anything.

choices.label: Shoot the talkie test reel

effects.text: The reel screens twice on the lot. By evening, {client} has a voice — officially.

choices.outcome: Lower, slower, dangerous — the voice fits the face now. The studios put the whispers away.
choices.outcome_fail: Under the lights the old fear returns. The reel vanishes into a drawer — and the whispers grow louder.
